# Marionette v5

Version-matched Markdown for `marionette` v5, whose core requires neither Backbone nor jQuery; Backbone Models and Collections integrate through optional adapters. `backbone.marionette` is the legacy package: check the installed name and version before choosing contracts. Choose the relevant task or exact reference directly; use the index for browsing.

- [Documentation index](docs/readme.md)
- [Agent workflow](docs/agents.md)
- [Install and render a View](docs/quick-start.md)
- [Ownership and lifetimes](docs/architecture.md)
- [API index](docs/api.md)
